# bigbullui — Full Component & Agent Specification

> AUTO-GENERATED by `scripts/generate-llms-full.mjs` on 2026-09-08 — do not edit by hand, regenerate with `node scripts/generate-llms-full.mjs`.

> Complete catalog of 659 zero-dependency React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 components with Ticket Stub aesthetic.

## Installation & CLI
```bash
# Add components via zero-dep CLI:
npx bigbullui add <component-name>
# Or install all-in-one package:
npm install bigbullui
```

## Tailwind CSS v4 Setup
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "bigbullui/css";
```

## Core Architecture Rules
1. Components in `src/components/ui/*` import ONLY `react` and `./lib/utils`.
2. No third-party packages (no Radix, no Lucide, no Framer Motion).
3. All styles use semantic Tailwind tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`).
4. Keyboard focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2 ring-ring`) and `motion-reduce` fallbacks are built-in.

## Icons (1023, bigbullicons package)
Hand-drawn Ticket Stub stroke icons. Install: `npm install bigbullicons`, use `<StampIcon name="ticket" size={20} />`. Props: `name` (required), `size` (default 20), `animated` (default true), `animation` ("draw"|"pulse"|"spin"|"none"). Gallery: https://ui.bigbullapp.com/icons, per-icon pages at https://ui.bigbullapp.com/icons/<name>, single-icon CLI: `npx bigbullui add icon-<name>`.
